The Wireless Network Link Terminal is your key into the wireless EU network.

It intelligently links machines into your wireless network through Link Anchor covers: energy terminals pull power on demand, dynamo terminals feed it back — §aa lean buffer keeps cache pressure low while staying fast§r.

By default it interacts with the network every §e600 ticks (30 seconds)§r; the interaction frequency and the up/downlink losses can be changed in §b§nconfig/gtswn/gtswn_network.cfg§r §7(InteractionRateTicks)§r. §cWarning: cranking the interaction frequency way up significantly increases performance overhead.§r

Shift+right-click it to switch between Energy mode (draw from the network) and Power mode (feed the network). The item texture always shows which mode is active.
